item.title: Stanford Abundance attends Progressive Abundance festival in Los Angeles
item.description: Members of Stanford Abundance traveled to Los Angeles this weekend to attend the Festival of Progressive Abundance, where they heard from the lawmakers, authors, and organizers shaping the Abundance movement. The post Stanford Abundance attends Progressive Abundance festival in Los Angeles appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Trump nominates Hoover Fellow Kevin Warsh ’92 as next Federal Reserve chair
item.description: Stanford alumnus Kevin Warsh ’92 will take over for Jerome Powell, who has faced increasing pressure from Trump to cut interest rates. The post Trump nominates Hoover Fellow Kevin Warsh ’92 as next Federal Reserve chair appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Levine | ICE is doing its job. That’s the problem.
item.description: Columnist Jennifer Levine addresses recent brutalities committed by ICE and their connection to the agency's original mission. The post Levine | ICE is doing its job. That’s the problem. appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Celebrity doctor Peter Attia M.D. ’01 gave Epstein medical advice, traded crude comments about women
item.description: The Stanford-trained researcher frequently emailed and met with the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, providing medical advice and making crude jokes about women. item.title: AAUP | “Viewpoint diversity” isn’t about viewpoint diversity
item.description: History professor Jessica Riskin writes on behalf of the AAUP arguing that "viewpoint diversity" is a false pretense for legitimizing extremist views and minimizing productive discourse. The post AAUP | “Viewpoint diversity” isn’t about viewpoint diversity appeared first on The Stanford Daily.
